admission.mechanism: FIRST-CLASS R5.56 machinery (crates/hh-env/src/egress_profile.rs; ADR-0421): admit_declared_deps mutates the attached ContainmentPolicy to net.mode=public + declared residual_channels[host_bridge], stamps the record ext (egress_profile/cell_network/policy_net_mode/declared_deps), and podman_helper_args appends `--network bridge` to the stock hh-helper spawn argv. The scratch /tmp/s4-helper-egress variant is superseded — never used in this epoch.
admission.verifier_bound: R5.57 first-class (crates/hh-env/src/verifier_bound.rs; ADR-0422): the ten swe-bench-astropy-2 specs carry task_id + enforced max_test_timeout_sec=360; admit_verifier_bound stamps 900 + the verbatim verifier_bound_admission record; verifier_deadline_ms derives min(decl,900s) on tc-verdict + tc-vendored; verifier_bound_admitted echoed per row. The recorded proximate cause was the bootstrap cwd/pytest bake, not the bound — a still-failing bootstrap records inconclusive{reason} verbatim.
admission.policy: net.mode=public for admitted cells — the N4-honest declaration (kernel authority + declared residual_channels[host_bridge]); fs/proc boundaries unchanged and still probed
admission.scope: only slots whose tasks declare runtime egress deps (the same mechanical scan verbatim); all 5 tasks declared deps
admission.fix_git: permanently unbuildable — the deleted upstream is not a resource bound. The client build was attempted once on the remote (verbatim rc 128 on `git clone` of the deleted repo); all ten slots record inconclusive{upstream_deleted} verbatim — never executed, never fabricated.
admission.first_attempt_semantics: named supplement attempts on the same frozen slots (same slot_ref/arm/lane/round; the frozen manifest consumed verbatim, never re-picked). `first` marks the manifest's round-0 subjects; supplement_epoch + prior_disposition mark the attempt lineage verbatim — the original records stand.
